subject: Post-demo: context depth & pricing ops — confirm token profile
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Erin Walsh <erin@bluewavehealth.com>, James O'Neil <james@bluewavehealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: context depth & pricing ops — confirm token profile

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning — appreciate the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and three asks so we can run accurate pricing scenarios: 

Recap (from today's call)
- Use case: clinical notes summarization + long-form Q&A for provider portal. Some downstream reranking for search.
- Expected traffic pattern: mostly interactive sessions (web UI + API), peak concurrency ~120 qps, average session length ~3 exchanges.
- Data sensitivity: PHI mix (we discussed Private deployment options later in the funnel).

Asks to finalize pricing scenarios (can you reply inline):
1) Average prompt tokens per request (typical user prompt + system prompt) — ballpark is fine (e.g., 300–700).
2) Average completion tokens returned per request (summary size / answer length).
3) Percent of sessions that need extended context (>=32k) and extreme context (>=128k).
4) Monthly token volume / budget range you are comfortable with (approx $/month).

What we'll deliver after your reply:
- Two pricing scenarios (pay-as-you-go, and committed/monthly) with unit economics modeled at your average tokens and at 3 conservative traffic tiers.
- Cost breakdown per 1M tokens at each context profile (8k/32k/128k) and suggested batching/caching settings to hit your target $/1M.

Attachments: pricing-model-v1.xlsx (stub) and sample-payloads.json — the sample payloads will help us validate tokenization.

Next step: if you can reply with the four points above by EOD Wednesday (2/10), Jordan and I will build the number scenarios and send a 30-minute follow-up for Wednesday/Thursday.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199


From: Erin Walsh <erin@bluewavehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: James O'Neil <james@bluewavehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 09:20:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-demo: context depth & pricing ops — confirm token profile

Neha — thanks for the clear recap. Answers below (we measured from a one-week pilot + engineering estimates):

1) Avg prompt tokens: ~450 tokens (system + user + metadata). Range per request: 180–1,200.
2) Avg completion tokens: ~1,100 tokens (summaries vary; short answers ~200, deep summarize ~3k).
3) Context needs:
   - ~4% of sessions require >8k context (long patient history stitching),
   - ~0.6% require >32k,
   - ~0.05% spike to >128k (rare archive retrievals).
4) Monthly volume & budget: target launch month ~80M tokens, ramp to ~450M tokens/month over 12 months. Initial budget band for infra + inference: $20k–$45k/month. Senior management wants a target unit cost under $100 per 1M tokens as a sanity check, but they asked us to see what options look like at $60–$90 per 1M.

Also: a couple clarifications — peak concurrency of 120 qps is correct for peak day, but sustained QPS is closer to 25. We can provide sample traces and a small histogram of token lengths if that helps.

If possible, can you show us 3 scenarios: (A) pay-as-you-go, (B) 12-month commit with 15% discount, (C) committed + reserved capacity (SLA) pricing? We care most about the unit $/1M token number at the avg profile and at a 95th percentile profile.

Thanks,
Erin Walsh
Director, Product — BlueWave Health
erin@bluewavehealth.com
office: +1 (617) 555-0211

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: context depth & pricing ops — confirm token profile

Neha — copying a quick internal note here so we can align before we send Erin the numbers: 

- Use Erin's avg tokens (prompt 450 / completion 1100) and volumes (80M initial -> 450M).
- Show per-1M token cost table for 8k/32k/128k contexts. For the rare 128k use-case, show fallback model option + on-demand private instance cost (since those drive price).
- Build three scenarios Erin asked for: PAYG, 12mo commit (15% off), Dedicated reserved pool (SLA + nvlink GPU).
- Include a line-item for batching benefits — show conservative and aggressive batching to demonstrate $/1M delta.

Ask Neha: can you request the sample traces Erin mentioned and ask for a one-pager with example prompt+response sizes per call (we need a histogram of tokens per message)? That will let our optimizer estimate KV cache hit rates.

I can draft the scenario numbers; split workload assumptions so we can present a midpoint and an upside. Send Erin by EOD Thursday.

-Jordan

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Erin Walsh <erin@bluewavehealth.com>, James O'Neil <james@bluewavehealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: context depth & pricing ops — confirm token profile

Erin / James — thanks for the fast turnaround and the helpful numbers. Attaching the pricing-model-v1.xlsx and sample-payloads.json. Below are the headline scenarios (very high level) based on the avg profile (prompt 450 / completion 1100):

Headline estimates (per 1M tokens):
- PAYG (no commitment): $120 / 1M tokens (8k context baseline kernel)
- 12mo commit (15% discount off PAYG): $102 / 1M tokens
- Dedicated Reserved (SLA, reserved capacity + nvlink): $78 / 1M tokens (assumes 250k tokens/sec sustained batching and 10% batching efficiency improvement)

Context multipliers (relative to 8k baseline):
- 32k profile: +18% cost (due to memory pressure and longer KV throughput)
- 128k profile: +140% cost for on-demand (we recommend a fallback model: serve 128k with a heavy quantized variant + reserved burst nodes; implying effective $/1M closer to +60% if you commit to dedicated instances)

Example: at Erin's initial month (80M tokens):
- PAYG ~ $9.6k / month
- 12mo commit ~ $8.2k / month
- Dedicated reserved ~ $6.24k / month (note: dedicated includes a minimum reserved baseline capacity commitment)

Notes & assumptions (short):
- These assume avg prompt/completion noted and 4% >8k, 0.6% >32k, 0.05% >128k as you reported.
- We bake in conservative batching (10% token reduction) and prefix caching for repeated patient prompts.
- Private/VPC add-ons, encryption-at-rest, and support SLAs are additional line items (we'll break out in the spreadsheet).

Next steps:
1) Please share the sample traces / histogram Erin offered (attach to reply).
2) Pick a 30-min window for follow-up next week — Jordan will bring a committed scenario with slide-level assumptions.

If you'd like, Jordan and I can also show a modeled target $/1M to hit their $60–$90 goal and what commit level that would require.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: pricing-model-v1.xlsx (pricing matrix), sample-payloads.json (tokenized example payloads)
